name: severe combined immunodeficiency due to CARD11 deficiency
description: Severe combined immunodeficiency due to CARD11 deficiency is a rare combined T and B cell immunodeficiency characterized by normal numbers of T and B lymphocytes, increased numbers of transitional B cells and hypo- to agammaglobulinemia, decreased numbers of regulatory T cells and defects in T-cell functions. It presents with severe susceptibility to infections, including opportunistic infections.
